language.name: The Ledger Nightly
language.rationale: Rooted in The Ledger's austere monochrome conviction, this language prioritises journalistic weight and editorial restraint. Crisp sharp planes, a hairline top rule, generous typographic breathing room, and a measured reveal convey authoritative, uncompromising public-service reporting.

notes: structure and spacing: platform-owned (airy density - 33/46px padding, 16px line gap, at scale 1)
accent: a rule across the top of the panel, one clear space above the words
motion: reveal at measured pace → preset line-reveal
